# -h documents every flag and exits successfully; an unknown flag is rejected
# with the flag package's message and usage.

loopvec -h
! stdout .
stderr -count=1 '^Usage of \S+:$'
stderr -count=1 '^  -d	display unified diff instead of rewritten source$'
stderr -count=1 '^  -methods$'
stderr -count=1 '^    	rewrite loops inside methods \(requires Go 1.28\+ / gotip CL 839405 to avoid compiler crash\)$'
stderr -count=1 '^  -split$'
stderr -count=1 '^    	write simd variant to file_simd.go and add //go:build !goexperiment.simd to original$'
stderr -count=1 '^  -w	write result to source files in place$'

! loopvec -bogus
! stdout .
stderr -count=1 '^flag provided but not defined: -bogus$'
stderr -count=1 '^Usage of \S+:$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
